title: Crestline Corporate Travel Agreements Booking Channels, Tour Code and Ticket Allowances
content:
Each tier of Crestline Corporate Travel Agreements names its own eligible booking channels and its own ticket allowances.

**Tier matrix.** A ticket is booked under the agreement only through one of the tier's eligible booking channels, and on every tier the agreement's tour code must be on the booking for the ticket to count under the agreement. The change fee waiver covers change fees and same-day change fees on tickets booked under the agreement; the traveler reassignment allowance lets an unflown ticket booked under the agreement be reassigned to another traveler on the active roster; the corporate checked bag allowance is the number of checked bags included per direction; credit pooling lets a credit from a ticket booked under the agreement pay for another roster traveler's ticket under the same agreement.

| Tier | Eligible booking channels | Tour code required | Change fee waiver | Traveler reassignment | Checked bags per direction | Credit pooling |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Crestline Business Connect | Crestline website, Crestline app | yes | no | no | 0 | no |
| Crestline Business Connect Plus | Crestline website, Crestline app, corporate booking tool | yes | no | no | 0 | no |
| Crestline Corporate Select | corporate booking tool, travel agency, reservations call center | yes | yes | no | 1 | no |
| Crestline Corporate Preferred | corporate booking tool, travel agency, reservations call center | yes | yes | no | 1 | yes |
| Crestline Corporate Premier | corporate booking tool, travel agency, reservations call center | yes | yes | yes | 2 | yes |
| Crestline Corporate Strategic | corporate booking tool, travel agency, reservations call center | yes | yes | yes | 2 | yes |

### Questions the matrix answers

**Is a ticket booked at the airport counter booked under the agreement?** No tier lists the airport counter among its eligible booking channels, so such a ticket is not booked under the agreement on any tier.

**Can a Crestline Corporate Select traveler's unflown ticket pass to a colleague on the roster?** No; traveler reassignment is marked "no" for Crestline Corporate Select. It is marked "yes" only for Crestline Corporate Premier and Crestline Corporate Strategic.

**Does a Crestline Business Connect Plus booking made on the Crestline app count?** The Crestline app is eligible for that tier; the ticket also needs the agreement's tour code on the booking.
